items.title: Laurence Juber interviewed by Monk Rowe, Glasgow, Scotland, July 27, 2016 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: I just did an album of improvisations with William Goldstein who is a film composer... And he and I improvised an album which just came out a few months ago.

ctx.x: Do you sort of take it in stride, or are there time that you reflect on the fact that, well I’ve played with most of the Beatles and I’ve played under George Martin and these are people I listened to when I was 15. What a life?

Oh I mean it’s an amazing life. But I think that I’m still learning. And I still look forward to the times when I get to work with somebody of stature, musical stature. Or not necessarily stature but of musical depth. And just how much more there is to learn. I love being able to go into a concert with an orchestra or a session with an orchestra. Because I get home and I pick up my acoustic guitar and I’ve got bassoons and I’ve got cellos and I’ve got inner parts all — guitar orchestration is part of what I do.…
